data.name: Treadwall M4 Climbing Simulator
data.description: Condition: Good used condition. The unit is fully functional but has been sitting in storage unused for the last few years. It will likely require a minor tune-up/lubrication before entering regular, heavy use. Model: M4P (4-foot-wide climbing surface). Serial Number: 0727 M4P. Features: Smooth hydraulic braking system, adjustable climbing speed, and variable angles to change difficulty. Perfect for home gyms, climbing gyms, training facilities, or school fitness rooms.
